notes.title: Game Update #6 : Chime Puzzle Changes
notes.notes:
[u][b]Game Update Notes[/b][/u]

The following changes has been made to the chime puzzle.

[list]
[*] There will be a switch outside of the storeroom. Interacting with it will turn on the lights in the storeroom.
[*] Display numbers that were previously in pharmacy has been moved directly to the storeroom.
[/list]

With the following changes, the chime puzzle will be more straight forward and less confusing as to how the puzzle actually works.

notes.title: Game Update #4 : Tutorial Introduction Improvements
notes.notes:

An improvement has been made for the tutorial introduction 
(the scene after you press play at the starting lobby)

[/list]

Have a nice day, everyone!

notes.title: Game Update #3
notes.notes:
[u][b]Game Update Notes[/b][/u]

With a handful of players prefering to use the WSAD keys for movement, I have implemented the following.

[list]
[*] "W" Key has been registered and can be used to enter doors.
[*] "A" & "D" Keys can also be used as movement. (was previously already registered)
[/list]

Hope this makes Overslept alittle more enjoyable for players prefering these keys!

notes.title: Game Update #2
notes.notes:
[b][u]Game Update Notes[/u][/b]

After monitoring the gameplay of Overslept Players, I decided to slightly lessen the encounters with Mr.Vartik (one of the antagonists of the Overslept). 

With this change, on average, players should find themselves meeting with Mr.Vartik about 5-15% lesser,  depending on how you approach the game!

[olist]
[*] Slightly lessen the encounters with Mr. Vartik.
[/olist]
